home.description: Smarter CV review powered by AI. Compare candidate qualifications against job requirements, identify the strongest matches, and keep the final hiring decision in human hands.
home.workflowDescription: From defining the job requirements to reviewing the final result, HR AI keeps the process simple, clear, and organized.

step1.title: Define Requirements
step1.description: Create clear job requirements including skills, experience, education, and certifications.

step2.title: Process CVs
step2.description: Upload candidate CVs and process them using RAG and LLM-powered analysis.

step3.title: Review Results
step3.description: Review AI-assisted results, compare requirements, and make the final human decision.

home.teamDescription: The team behind the HR AI CV review platform.

setup.title: Job Requirements & CV Upload
setup.description: Define the job requirements candidates will be evaluated against, then upload the CVs you want to process.
setup.jobRequirementsDescription: Configure up to three job requirements for the CV review process.

cvUpload.addAtLeastOne: Add at least one CV to continue.
